assertions.title: Root `check-types` is no longer a no-op

steps.action: Run `bun run check-types` from repo root
steps.expected: Turbo executes at least one real workspace `check-types` task

terminalSnapshots: `bun run check-types` -> `Running check-types in 4 packages` and `@platform/env:check-types: $ tsc --noEmit`

steps.expected: Typechecking participants define real `check-types` scripts or are intentionally not part of check-types execution
steps.observed: `packages/env/package.json` defines `check-types: tsc --noEmit`; `bun run check-types` executes that script; `apps/web`, `packages/backend`, and `packages/typescript-config` have no `check-types` script and were not executed as `check-types` tasks

terminalSnapshots: Turbo output shows the only executed check-types task: `@platform/env:check-types`

assertions.title: Relevant workspaces expose aligned `check` / `fix` scripts where intended

steps.expected: Workspace scripts align to root tooling model
steps.observed: `apps/web`, `packages/backend`, and `packages/env` define `check`/`fix` as `bun run --cwd ../.. check|fix`, matching root model

assertions.title: Turbo task graph matches implemented validation flow

steps.expected: Turbo graph and root scripts reflect actual validation execution
steps.observed: `turbo.json` defines `check-types`, `check`, and `fix` tasks; root `package.json` maps `check-types` to `turbo check-types`; command execution confirmed real task run

terminalSnapshots: `bun run check-types` succeeded with Turbo task execution

assertions.title: Shared config package supports successful repo typechecking

steps.action: Run `bun run check-types` and inspect for shared-config resolution errors
steps.expected: Typecheck succeeds without `@platform/config` or preset resolution failures
steps.observed: Typecheck command exited 0 and showed no missing shared config or legacy package resolution errors

terminalSnapshots: `bun run check-types` -> exit 0; no resolution errors in output

assertions.title: Accepted validation gate passes end to end from repo root

steps.observed: Ultracite check completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors

assertions.title: TypeScript config rename and tooling migration are mutually compatible

steps.action: Run gate commands and search for stale validation-path references
steps.expected: Gate commands pass and no active stale references in validation path
steps.observed: Both gate commands exited 0; no matches for `@platform/config`, `@biomejs/biome`, `biome.json`, or `ultracite/biome` in inspected validation-path configs/manifests

assertions.title: Final repo structure matches approved mission shape

steps.action: Inspect root and packages structure plus required config files
steps.expected: `packages/typescript-config`, `.oxlintrc.json`, and `.oxfmtrc.jsonc` exist; no active legacy `packages/config` artifact
steps.observed: `packages/typescript-config` exists; root `.oxlintrc.json` and `.oxfmtrc.jsonc` exist; glob search found no `packages/config/**`

frictions.description: `bun run check-types` output showed only one executed task due cache replay and script distribution, which obscures workspace-level intent at first glance.
frictions.resolution: Correlated Turbo output with workspace `package.json` script audit to confirm intended command-surface participation.

summary: Tested 8 assertions: 8 passed, 0 failed, 0 blocked. Required root commands (`bun run check`, `bun run check-types`) both succeeded with evidence captured from command output and config/script inspection.
